categories.label: Access and numbering
categories.summary: Who may do what, in which branch, and how documents are numbered.

categories.label: Catalogue and pricing
categories.summary: Billable items, tariffs, tax, discounts and published commercial releases.

categories.label: Payers and coverage
categories.summary: Insurers, TPAs, plans, contracts and what each branch accepts.

categories.label: Billing policy and models
categories.summary: The tenant billing policy and every reimbursement model it can select.

categories.label: Exchange and providers
categories.summary: Payer exchange profiles and payment provider bindings.

categories.label: Accounting
categories.summary: Chart of accounts, posting mappings and fiscal periods.

categories.label: Platform
categories.summary: Workflow definitions, assistance and marketplace packages.

resources.label: Billing access grants
resources.summary: Per-identity, per-branch billing permissions. The latest grant for a person and branch is the one that counts.

fields.label: Identity subject
fields.help: Verified identity UUID from the identity provider.

fields.label: Grant enabled
fields.help: A later disabled grant revokes access; an older enabled grant never revives it.

fields.label: Permissions
fields.help: READ is required with every operational permission.

resources.label: Commercial authority
resources.summary: Explicit rights to read, author or publish commercial catalogue tables. Module access alone is not enough.

fields.label: Scope target
fields.help: Price book or party code when the scope is narrower than the tenant.

resources.label: Document numbering
resources.summary: Number sequences consumed when invoices, receipts, credit notes and claims are issued.

fields.label: Pattern
fields.help: Tokens: {BR} branch, {YYYY} year, {MM} month, {SEQ:n} zero-padded sequence.

resources.label: Items and services
resources.summary: The billable service catalogue: kind, unit, category and tax classification.

resources.label: Categories and terminology
resources.summary: Category tree, service groups and the terminology releases items are coded against.

resources.label: Tax rules
resources.summary: Jurisdiction tax treatment per tax category. Missing treatment sends charges to review — never to zero tax.

resources.label: Price books and prices
resources.summary: Tariff books with currency, precision and rounding, and the item rates inside each book.

resources.label: Discounts
resources.summary: Governed discounts with scope, eligibility, combination and before- or after-tax timing.

resources.label: Modifiers and MPR
resources.summary: Procedure modifiers and multiple-procedure reduction ranks used by FFS_MODIFIERS pricing.

resources.label: Commercial releases
resources.summary: Immutable publication of commercial versions. Imported catalogues are not live until a release is approved.

resources.label: Payers, TPAs and sponsors
resources.summary: Tenant financial identities for insurers, payers, TPAs and corporate sponsors.

fields.label: Payer exchange ID
fields.help: Identifier used by exchange routes. Not a credential.

resources.label: Networks
resources.summary: Commercial networks referenced by plans, contracts and branch arrangements.

resources.label: Plans and benefit rules
resources.summary: Risk bearer, administrator and network for each plan, with the benefit rules that split liability.

resources.label: Contracts
resources.summary: Effective commercial terms binding a party, plan and network to a price book.

resources.label: Branch arrangements
resources.summary: The exact insurer, TPA, plan, network and contract combinations each branch accepts.

fields.label: Acceptance notes
fields.help: Accepting one insurer never accepts its other plans or networks.

resources.label: Benefit pools
resources.summary: Explicit family or aggregate deductible, out-of-pocket and maximum-benefit pools.

resources.label: Billing policy
resources.summary: The tenant default and permitted branch overrides. Billing stays closed without an approved, enabled tenant default.

resources.label: Reimbursement routes
resources.summary: Mixed-model selection by item, category, contract and care setting. Priority wins first, then specificity.

fields.label: Items
fields.help: Required when the scope is Item.

fields.label: Category
fields.help: Required when the scope is Category.

fields.label: Model configuration pin
fields.help: FFS routes must not pin a configuration; all other models must.

resources.label: Stay and case models
resources.summary: Per-diem day bands and case-rate packages priced from the actual accommodation ledger.

resources.label: DRG configuration
resources.summary: Licensed grouper binding, weight table and the local contract overlay. Not a national certified algorithm.

fields.label: Licence reference
fields.help: Deployment trust and runtime binding are configured separately.

resources.label: Category rates
resources.summary: Diagnosis-based classification rules and rates. Lower rule priority numbers win here.

resources.label: E&M level tables
resources.summary: Professional and facility level tables used by the dedicated E&M determination workflow.

resources.label: Advanced models
resources.summary: Capitation, bundle, global budget, pay-for-performance and cost-plus contract settlements.

resources.label: Exchange profiles and routes
resources.summary: Approved message profiles and payer routes. Endpoints and credentials stay deployment-owned.

fields.label: Endpoint alias
fields.help: Alias resolved by the deployment. Never a URL or secret.

resources.label: Payment and refund providers
resources.summary: Collection and refund payout bindings. A simulator never moves real money.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: Live mode still requires deployment trust and partner certification.

resources.label: Chart of accounts
resources.summary: Legal-entity accounts. Nothing is seeded automatically in production.

resources.label: GL mappings
resources.summary: Versioned role-to-account mappings. A missing mapping fails posting closed and is shown as an exception.

resources.label: Fiscal periods
resources.summary: Open, soft-closed and closed accounting periods per legal entity.

resources.label: Workflows and rules
resources.summary: Versioned checkpoint graphs for claims, appeals and collections. They add guards; they never remove financial checks.

resources.label: Assistance and marketplace
resources.summary: AI assistance profiles and marketplace packages. Installation never grants authority.

fields.label: Human review required
fields.help: Always on. Assistance never writes clinical or financial records.

checks.label: Model pins for the default model
